messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Paging @oncall (sev=P1) — multiple tokenizer pods OOM in us-west-2a causing generation requests to 503. Auto-eviction observed. Logs attached to incident 2155554321.

 eva: seeing it, joining. 503 spikes and Kube events show "Memory cgroup exceeded" and kernel OOMs on several tokenizer containers.

 mike: confirmed from pod logs — sample: 
```
RuntimeError: Out of memory while allocating tensor
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
[kernel] Out of memory: Kill process 2345 (tokenizer) score 987
cgroup memory: usage 1.9G limit 2.0G -> killed
```

 jordan: last deploy to tokenizer happened ~18:22 UTC, rolled out feature: heuristic-preproc. Commit 3f9a7b2. Could be increased CPU/mem path.

 priya: traffic pattern: a single customer sent many long prompts (avg tokens ~12k) triggering worst-case prefix build. Noticed many streams hitting the same preproc worker (no sharding).

 eva: quick mitigation idea: reduce TOKENIZER_CONCURRENCY and scale replicas so each has less burst. Also throttle requests at edge for long prompts.

 mike: can we patch the deployment? suggestion: 
```
kubectl set env deploy/tokenizer TOKENIZER_CONCURRENCY=3 -n inference-prod
kubectl patch deploy/tokenizer -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"tokenizer","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"1500Mi"},"requests":{"memory":"800Mi"}}}]}}}}' -n inference-prod
```

 ops-bot: Deploy bot: starting rolling restart of deployment/tokenizer in inference-prod (strategy=RollingUpdate).

 jordan: also seeing node flaps in us-west-2a (kernel OOMs) — cordon the worst node(s) first: node/usw2a-cpu-77.

 priya: customer impact: CS dashboard shows ~600 failed /generate calls in last 10m for customer: monoretail-inc. Escalating to CS.

 eva: doing the patch now. will keep TOKENIZER_CONCURRENCY at 2 if we still see flaps.

 mike: after patch, ``kubectl get pods -n inference-prod -o wide | grep tokenizer`` shows pods cycling but a few remain CrashLoopBackOff. Attaching pod describe snippet: 
```
Events:
  Warning  OOMKilled  30s  kubelet  Container killed due to memory usage
  Normal   BackOff    12s  kubelet  Back-off restarting failed container
```

 jordan: quick root-cause hypothesis: heuristic-preproc amplification for long prompts created superlinear CPU + mem growth due to retry loops + memcpy path. Need code patch to cap buffer growth.

 priya: for live mitigation: 1) incrementally reduce concurrency env, 2) cordon problematic nodes, 3) create temporary rate-limit for long prompts (>= 8k tokens) at edge LB. I'll raise a prod rule now.

 eva: doing the edge rule: rate-limit token-length >=8000 to 1 req/min per IP for 15m. Patch applied.

 ops-bot: Rule applied to LB: long-prompt-throttle-2155554321 (active).

 mike: after throttle + concurrency drop, error rate to /generate dropped from 55% -> 12% over 8 minutes. Some pods still OOMing but rate reduced.

 jordan: marking nodes for safer drain: 
```
kubectl cordon node/usw2a-cpu-77
kubectl drain node/usw2a-cpu-77 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

 priya: CS update: monoretail-inc seeing degraded response quality/timeouts 18:20-18:40 UTC. They're asking for ETA.

 eva: ETA: full stabilization target 30 minutes from now. postmortem will include mitigation steps and permanent limits.

 mike: noticing CUDA errors on one pod as it fell back to CPU: "CUDA out of memory" then container OOM. Might need to pin GPU workload to separate nodes.

 jordan: filed tech task to separate GPU tokenizer pool from CPU fallback: INF-7823.

 ops-bot: Incident 2155554321 updated: severity P1 -> P1 (mitigating). Tags: tokenizer, preproc, memory, oncall-handoff.

 eva: next steps for remediation: 1) revert heuristic-preproc commit 3f9a7b2 from prod canary -> if mitigates, plan safe rollback, 2) add hard buffer caps in preproc code, 3) add autoscale rule by long-prompt metric.

 priya: will coordinate rollback if needed. preparing cherry-pick.

 alex: taking over on-call in 15m. eva handing off: current status — concurrency=3, LB throttle active, nodes cordoned, error rate down to ~8-10%. I'll keep monitoring.

 eva: handing off to alex — full notes in incident doc. tagging @ops-bot to keep watch and alert if error rate >20% for next 30m. :thumbsup:

 ops-bot: Watch rule set: error-rate-monitor-2155554321 (threshold 20%) active.

 alex: acknowledged. I'll escalate to distro if more OOMs appear.

 priya: CS notified monoretail-inc with timeline and mitigation steps. escalation email sent.

 mike: logging summary for postmortem: peeked at heap growth graphs — buffer growth correlates with prompt length distribution. Attach Grafana panel IDs: g/inference/peak-mem-2155 and g/inference/longprompts-2155.

 eva: closing live mitigation loop for now. Please add any outstanding action items to the incident doc.

 alex: thanks team. handover complete. incident status: monitoring -> stabilizing.
